metadata.title: CCCS SaaS FedRAMP Recognition Profile
metadata.remarks:
Legacy sample profile selections and parameter assignments are preserved. Control titles, statements and discussion now use the published March 31, 2026 CCCS ITSP.10.033 catalog. This is a versioned sample, not a certification that the cloud/FedRAMP/PBHVA allocations reflect a newly issued baseline. Review applicability and organization-defined values before operational use.

Control text: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security, Security and privacy controls and assurance activities catalogue (ITSP.10.033), March 31, 2026; an unofficial reproduction of the publication at the reference URL.
